title: DPSF-Net: A Dual-Prior Spatial-Frequency Network for Real-World Remote Sensing Image Dehazing
abstract: arXiv:2609.06962v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world remote sensing image dehazing (RSID) remains challenging because atmospheric scattering, spatially non-uniform haze and colour distortion jointly degrade structural and spectral information. Most deep learning methods rely on RGB inputs and spatial-domain feature extraction, which limits their ability to separate global background haze from local surface details. Here, we propose DPSF-Net, a dual-prior spatial-frequency network built on MCAF-Net for real-world RSID. The network uses hazy RGB images and dark channel prior (DCP) maps as joint inputs, allowing physical degradation cues to guide end-to-end feature learning. A spatial-frequency residual interaction block introduces a FourierUnit branch into multi-directional spatial interaction to model large-scale haze components. translated_title: DPSF-Net：一种用于真实世界遥感图像去雾的双先验空间-频率网络
translated_abstract: 真实世界遥感图像去雾（RSID）仍然具有挑战性，因为大气散射、空间非均匀雾霭和颜色失真会共同损害图像的结构和光谱信息。大多数深度学习方法依赖RGB输入和空间域特征提取，这限制了它们将全局背景雾霭与局部地表细节分离的能力。在此，我们提出了DPSF-Net，一种建立在MCAF-Net基础上的双先验空间-频率网络，用于真实世界遥感图像去雾。该网络使用有雾RGB图像和暗通道先验（DCP）图作为联合输入，使物理退化线索能够引导端到端的特征学习。空间-频率残差交互块将傅里叶单元分支引入多方向空间交互中，以建模大尺度雾霭成分。先验引导的特征注意力模块自适应地融合先验特征与注意力特征，以减少颜色偏移和结构畸变。
tldr: DPSF-Net通过将有雾RGB图像与暗通道先验图联合输入，并融合空间-频率残差交互和先验引导特征注意力机制，有效实现了真实世界遥感图像去雾，减少了颜色偏移和结构畸变。
en_tdlr: DPSF-Net achieves real-world remote sensing image dehazing by jointly feeding hazy RGB images and dark channel prior maps, combining spatial-frequency residual interaction and prior-guided feature attention to reduce colour shift and structural distortion.
